_about: Scene list for the Saved replies promo. Five scenes, drawn type and shapes only: the brand has no real product UI, so no inbox screen is invented. Scene times come from the voice once it is made.

planned_instant_changes.what: match cut from the last typed line into the saved card, on the 'Saved replies' downbeat

planned_holds.what: hold on the finished reply before the peak (the gap after line 05)

shots.move: a reply types out in a plain white card; the same words type again under it, faster

scenes.title: Same reply
scenes.hand_off: the word 'Again' stays while the stacked copies slide up and away

shots.move: the copies stack down the page, each a little fainter; slow drift
one clean reply types, then a bookmark mark draws itself on its corner
shots.sound: one key tap, then a soft click

shots.move: the saved card rises from the foot of the page, ready
three words land one by one on the card, then hold

scenes.title: Saved replies
scenes.hand_off: the card's shape is the shape the repeated copies folded into

shots.move: SIGNATURE: all the earlier copies fold into one amber-edged card and the title settles on it
shots.sound: soft click and a short held beat

shots.move: the card sits still; words fade up beneath it

scenes.title: Live today
scenes.hand_off: the card's green edge becomes the end card's background

shots.move: the logo lands, then rests; a short silent tail
